name: yolo-dag
description: Turns an ambiguous request into reviewed, independent, executable tasks: /brainstorm resolves ambiguity (autonomously, asking only when high-stakes) then hands off to the orchestrator, which fans out 8 parallel specialists each closed by a 3-reviewer/1-consolidator review loop, merges into one build spec, decomposes it into dependency-free tasks, then executes and verifies them in worker/reviewer batches of 10.
